description: Map single-author, never-reviewed files from authorship and review data: top-author share, external review coverage, and the at-risk list.

files.description: Files with their authorship and review data (at least one)

authors.description: Authors of the file with commit counts (at least one)

commits.description: Commits by this author to this file (at least 1)

reviewers.description: Names that reviewed changes to this file (optional, default [])

threshold.description: Top-author share at or above which a file is dominated by one author (optional, default 0.8, must be > 0 and <= 1)

name: analyze_bus_factor
